name: Sine Plasma

name: Polar Ring Clock

name: Popcorn Pot

name: Pricing Plan Toggle

note: A weather widget that slides from city to city, each with an animated sky icon, hourly temperatures and a five day outlook.

name: Wind Through Grass
note: A field of tall grass bends and shimmers silver as gusts of wind roll across it under a summer sky.

name: Windmill on a Hill
note: An old windmill on a green hill, its lattice sails turning above a striped tulip field at sunset.

name: Window Tiling Manager
note: A desktop where windows open one by one and the tiling layout slides between halves, columns and a grid.

name: Wireframe City Flyby
note: A night flight down a long avenue between wireframe towers, cyan and magenta edges racing past over a gridded street.

name: Wireframe Globe
note: A wire sphere of latitude and longitude lines turning on a tilted axis, near lines bright and far lines dim behind.

name: Line Drawn Maze Crawl
note: An early first-person maze game drawn in amber lines, gliding down corridors and turning at junctions by the right-hand rule while a map tracks each step.

name: Word Exchange
note: Everyday words trade like shares on a quote screen, with a crawling tape, a table of prices that tick up and down and a chart for the word of the hour.

name: Word Ladder Morph
note: A word ladder where one big letter at a time dissolves and re-forms into its neighbour, turning COLD into WARM while the steps are listed beside it.

name: World Map Pings
note: A dotted world map where live request pings flare up in cities and arcs carry traffic between them.

name: Yawning Coffee Mug
note: A sleepy coffee mug on its saucer gives a long stretchy yawn as curls of steam rise, then blinks itself wide awake.

name: Zigzag Rule
note: A doubled zigzag rule that scrolls sideways while a rainbow gradient slides along it.
